description: This file defines a LinkRenderer class responsible for rendering markdown links into Confluence-specific XML/HTML format, with special handling for internal and external URLs within a documentation generation context.

classes.name: LinkRenderer
classes.description: A class extending the base link renderer to output Confluence-compatible link markup, with URL validation and internal link resolution tailored for Confluence export.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a markdown link node into Confluence-specific HTML/XML, handling URL validation, internal link resolution, and constructing the appropriate Confluence markup including anchors and content titles.
